info.title: The Daily Machine Spirit: the rites API
info.summary: Every rite The Daily Machine Spirit has published, each Heretical Truth sealed until it's asked for.
info.description: Read-only and open: no sign-in, no key, and nothing about the caller is kept. Each answer has one address and is cached; a query string or a trailing slash is redirected (301) to the address without it, and any other spelling is not found. Fields may be added within v1; a client ignores what it doesn't know. The guide: https://github.com/mykolad/daily-machine-spirit/blob/master/docs/api.md

get.summary: Every published rite, the newest first, each Heretical Truth sealed

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: The rite's number, as listed: a whole number from 1, without leading zeros.

rites.description: Every published rite, the newest first.

number.description: The rite's number, NO. 12 on the site.

title.description: As published; commands and file names in `backticks`, an erased word an emoji.

text.description: As published; commands and file names in `backticks`, an erased word an emoji.

ailment.description: The trouble the rite is for, in a line, without its fix: what to match a trouble on. Empty for a rite that has none yet.

subjects.description: What it's filed under; empty for a rite filed under nothing.

url.description: The rite's page, where its Heretical Truth is a click away.

key.description: Never changes: match on it. The subject's page is /tags/{key}.

hereticalTruth.description: One or two plain sentences on what really happens, and what to do instead.

title.description: The kind of error: No such rite, Not a rite's number, Not this API's address, The rites can't be read just now.

ToTheAddress.description: A query string or a trailing slash: redirected to the address without it.

NotFound.description: No such rite, not a rite's number, or another spelling of the address. Not cached.

Unavailable.description: The rites can't be read just now: try again later. Not cached.
